messages:
Leah Kim: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need to finalize the customer comms decisions — canonical statuspage wording, how/when we publish redacted RCAs, and a recurrence escalation rule. Tracker: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-678/tracker :clipboard:

ops-bot: Postmortem uploaded: https://ourdocs.internal/incidents/INC-2026-678/postmortem (owner: @Leah Kim) :page_facing_up:

Omar Hassan: Proposal for statuspage: two public labels only: 'Degraded performance' and 'Partial outage'. Numeric thresholds in the template: Partial outage if user errors >=1% for >5m or p95 latency >2s for >10m. Simpler for customers.

Priya Shah: Agreed. For RCA sharing: short redacted customer summary published within 72h by default; 48h target if single-team mitigation. Full technical RCA available to consenting customers on request (NDA/EA) within 10 business days. Add a "consent_rca" flag in tracker for auto-send.

Leah Kim: Who signs off redactions? Current policy: Security + Legal + Incident Owner. Can Security alone approve internal-only redactions?

Priya Shah: Keep tri-signoff for external publish. For internal-only summaries, allow Security to approve with an "exception_reason" logged in tracker. Legal wants to review final external copy.

Omar Hassan: Recurrence rules: if subsystem has >=3 incidents in 30d mark as "recurring" -> auto-open follow-up ticket + email impacted subscribers. I'll own the detection job (A4) and add a weekly digest. Cron example: "0 5 * * Mon /opt/bin/recurrence-check --inc INC-2026-678 --window 30d --threshold 3"

Leah Kim: Action owners recap: A1 statuspage copy & numeric thresholds  Omar to finalize; A2 template fields + consent flag  Leah to update; A3 redaction signoff flow  Priya to draft + Legal review; A4 recurrence detection + digest  Omar to implement.

legal-bot: Legal note: consent language must be explicit and reversible. We'll review final summary before publishing externally. Tag legal@redwood.com for review.

Leah Kim: Thanks everyone. I'll update the postmortem template with the new SLA fields and the RCA_sharing_policy field, then circulate the tracker link for sign-offs in 24h. :white_check_mark:
